artifacts.feature: Outcome definition and first mission graph
artifacts.originalOverlay: Original cross-section seed, emerging root split, two dependency endpoints, registration marks, and live-copy safe zone.
artifacts.altRecommendation: A historic cherry study overlaid with a seed opening into a two-branch mission graph.
artifacts.liveLabelGuidance: Place the numbered outcome headline and action copy in the open upper/left field; keep all claims in HTML.

artifacts.feature: Parallel agent tasks, dependencies, and independently checked completion

artifacts.liveLabelGuidance: Anchor live worker names and statuses outside the SVG at the terminal-node positions; the SVG carries no labels.

artifacts.liveLabelGuidance: Place workspace names and boundary details in adjacent HTML; the compartments remain legible without embedded words.
